text: Nursing is a comprehensive applied discipline based on natural and social sciences, which studies the theories, knowledge, skills and development laws of nursing for maintaining, promoting and restoring human health. It not only focuses on the treatment of diseases, but also emphasizes the overall health care for individuals, families and groups, covering multiple dimensions such as physiology, psychology and society. The core of nursing is "patient-centeredness", which helps people achieve the best state of health through scientific nursing intervention, health guidance and humanistic care. It is an indispensable and important part of the modern medical system.
